comments.author: Curious
comments.body: What memorial album is she responsible for?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Truth of the Rumours(NO.2) -- the one which has Kettle Hat for a reward, and requires completion of 9 relic hunts (3 from Avalon, 3 from Those Who Fought Rome, 2 from Model Statesmen, and 1 from Created Destiny). Lucrezia will appear in Venice's church when you've finished the MA regardless of the current World Clock era; as well, if you never turn in the album, she'll never disappear and can be viewed at any time.

Source: lisdol.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-155.html
